en-US.author: Block, Inc.
en-US.description: An open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions — install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM.
en-US.longDescription:
Goose is an open source, extensible general-purpose AI agent that runs locally. It automates engineering tasks by installing, executing, editing, and testing with any LLM.
The CLI works with 15+ providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, and Bedrock, and extends through 70+ MCP (Model Context Protocol) extensions. Goose can act as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent for editors such as Zed and JetBrains IDEs, and supports ACP agents as providers.
en-US.name: goose CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ Features
- Opt-in context relevance operation #12589
- Context window report and viewer #10462
- AIHubMix declarative provider #12997
- RouterPlex declarative provider #13068
- Lemonade provider #12920
- Collapse thinking by default with a setting to control it (desktop) #12660
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Replace retired Spark X2 with Spark X2.5 in iflytek_astron #12772
- Show current session ID in /status #12607
- Keep session load on its replay fast path when stopped (desktop) #13190
- Replay OpenAI Responses reasoning across tool turns #13222
- Route bare OpenAI GPT IDs to Mantle by ID shape (bedrock) #13211
- Use supports_vision from /model/info (litellm) #13239
- Honor Retry-After on 429s mapped outside handle_status #12986
- Classify typed context_length_exceeded errors as context overflow (openrouter) #13154
- Report failed manual compaction as an error (acp) #13099
- Fall back to default inference for Bedrock provider models without document block support #12932
- Bump zstd to 0.14.3 for RUSTSEC advisories #13162
- Restore Linux window icons (desktop) #13120
- Resolve variant suffixes like :free and :nitro to the base model (openrouter) #12979
- Use catalog_provider_id for vision lookup on custom providers #12993
- Start the agent only once after a fork (desktop) #13139
- Remove jsonwebtoken to avoid ignoring its cargo-deny advisories #13141
- Use recipe settings in scheduled runs (scheduler) #13138
- Use system trust for WebSockets (voice) #13075
- Stop telling the model a screenshot tool exists (computercontroller) #13279
🔧 Improvements
- Replace Agent and AgentManager with one StateMachineServices per process #12880
- Drop tool-specific tool call titles (desktop) #13107
- Remove ACP client-delegated developer tools #13144
📚 Documentation
- Say that code is not the only way to contribute #13292
- Feature GDK on the main website #13245
- Give GDK its own navigation and developer guides #13165
- Fikra API example for custom OpenAI endpoints #13008

zh-CN.description: 一个开源、可扩展的 AI 智能体，超越代码补全——使用任何大语言模型安装、执行、编辑和测试。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Goose 是一个开源、可扩展的通用 AI 智能体，在本地运行。它通过使用任何大语言模型执行安装、执行、编辑和测试来自动完成工程任务。
该 CLI 支持 15 家以上的模型提供商，包括 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Ollama、OpenRouter、Azure 和 Bedrock，并可通过 70 多个 MCP（模型上下文协议）扩展进行扩展。Goose 可以作为面向 Zed、JetBrains IDE 等编辑器的智能体客户端协议（ACP）智能体，也支持将 ACP 智能体用作提供商。
